column1: # Swedish glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, not judged by the council; nothing here is final.
# Term column: Swedish forms separated by " | ", the first is canonical. Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them (scratch/english-fixes/d3-*).
# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. D3's new rows and renamed ids wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/sv.tsv until then.
# acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo must leave this file when D3 makes them do-not-translate, or glossary-check refuses the row.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Toppfart and the measured value Maxhastighet, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). Other keys with these terms already match D3.
